extensionName.description: Name of the extension (manifest). A product name: not translated.

extensionDescription.message: Native Exchange ActiveSync in Thunderbird: mail, calendar, contacts and tasks, with any compatible server.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension (manifest, add-ons manager).

languageTag.description: Language of this catalogue as a BCP 47 tag (lang attribute of the settings page).

actionSync.description: Toolbar button title, nothing synchronized yet.

actionSyncLast.description: Toolbar button title; $TIME$: time of the last successful synchronization.

actionCheckSettings.description: Toolbar button title when mailboxes have a problem; $NAMES$: their names, comma-separated.

syncRunning.description: Toolbar button title, and status of a mailbox, while a synchronization runs.

menuSyncOne.description: Context menu item of a Sync443 account in the folder pane.

pageOutsideThunderbird.message: This page only works when opened from Thunderbird, in the extension's settings.
pageOutsideThunderbird.description: Shown when the settings page is opened outside Thunderbird.

mailboxesTitle.description: Heading of the list of mailboxes.

mailboxesEmpty.message: No mailbox yet. Click “Add a mailbox”.
mailboxesEmpty.description: Shown when there is no mailbox; quotes the addMailbox button.

unnamed.description: Name shown for a mailbox that has neither name nor address.

confirmDeletes.description: Button: apply the deletions held back by the mass-deletion safeguard (messages, folders, events or tasks).

keepLocalCopies.description: Button: drop the deletions held back, keep the local messages, events and tasks.

syncButton.description: Button of a mailbox: synchronize it now.

removeButton.description: Button of a mailbox: remove it from Thunderbird (nothing is deleted on the server).

removeConfirmButton.description: Button confirming the removal of a mailbox.

removeQuestion.message: Remove the mailbox “$NAME$”? Its account, its local folders and its password will be removed from Thunderbird. Nothing is deleted on the server. Changes not yet sent to the server are lost.
removeQuestion.description: Asked before a mailbox is removed; $NAME$: its name.

discardConfirm.message: The deletions made on the server will not be applied: the messages, events and tasks concerned stay in Thunderbird. The mail folders concerned are synchronized again with the server; the events and tasks kept are no longer linked to the server. A folder deleted on the server stays here, without synchronization.
discardConfirm.description: Asked before the deletions held back are dropped (keepLocalCopies); they may concern messages, mail folders, events or tasks.

discardContactsNote.message: The contacts concerned stay in Thunderbird too, and are no longer linked to the server.
discardContactsNote.description: Sentence added to discardConfirm when the mailbox synchronizes contacts.

uncheckCalendarConfirm.message: Stop synchronizing the calendar of “$NAME$”? Its events will be removed from Thunderbird. Nothing is deleted on the server. Changes not yet sent to the server are lost.
uncheckCalendarConfirm.description: Asked before a mailbox is saved with its calendar unchecked (it was synchronized until now); $NAME$: name of the mailbox.

uncheckTasksConfirm.message: Stop synchronizing the tasks of “$NAME$”? Its tasks will be removed from Thunderbird. Nothing is deleted on the server. Changes not yet sent to the server are lost.
uncheckTasksConfirm.description: Asked before a mailbox is saved with its tasks unchecked (they were synchronized until now); $NAME$: name of the mailbox.

uncheckContactsConfirm.message: Stop synchronizing the contacts of “$NAME$”? Its address books will be removed from Thunderbird. Nothing is deleted on the server. Changes not yet sent to the server are lost.
uncheckContactsConfirm.description: Asked before a mailbox is saved with its contacts unchecked (they were synchronized until now); $NAME$: name of the mailbox.

uncheckMailConfirm.message: Stop synchronizing the mail of “$NAME$”? The copies of its messages will be removed from Thunderbird; messages that exist only in Thunderbird stay. Nothing is deleted on the server. Actions not yet sent to the server are lost.
uncheckMailConfirm.description: Asked before a mailbox is saved with its mail unchecked (it was synchronized until now); $NAME$: name of the mailbox.

uncheckBothConfirm.message: Stop synchronizing the calendar and the tasks of “$NAME$”? Its calendars will be removed from Thunderbird, with their events and tasks. Nothing is deleted on the server. Changes not yet sent to the server are lost.
uncheckBothConfirm.description: Asked before a mailbox is saved with both its calendar and its tasks unchecked (they were synchronized until now); $NAME$: name of the mailbox.

moveConfirm.message: Change the server or the sign-in name of “$NAME$”? Its calendars and tasks will be removed from Thunderbird, then synchronized again from the server. Changes not yet sent to the server are lost.
moveConfirm.description: Asked before a mailbox whose calendar or tasks are synchronized is saved with another server or sign-in name; $NAME$: name of the mailbox.

moveContactsConfirm.message: Change the server or the sign-in name of “$NAME$”? Its address books will be removed from Thunderbird, then synchronized again from the server. Changes not yet sent to the server are lost.
moveContactsConfirm.description: Asked before a mailbox whose contacts are synchronized is saved with another server or sign-in name; $NAME$: name of the mailbox.

noAnswer.message: The extension is not responding. Reload this page.
noAnswer.description: The background page did not answer.

badAnswer.description: The background page gave an answer of an unexpected shape.

listFailed.message: The list of mailboxes could not be read.

editedRemoved.message: The mailbox being edited has been removed.

syncNotStarted.message: The synchronization could not be started.

deletesNotDiscarded.message: The deletions could not be set aside.

mailboxNotRemoved.message: The mailbox could not be removed.

mailboxAdded.message: Mailbox “$NAME$” added. First synchronization in progress.

mailboxNotSaved.message: The mailbox could not be saved.

logNotCleared.message: The log could not be cleared.

newMailbox.description: Title of the form, new mailbox.

editMailbox.description: Title of the form; $NAME$: name of the mailbox.

passwordHintNew.message: If the server allows it, prefer an app password reserved for ActiveSync.
passwordHintNew.description: Hint under the password, new mailbox.

passwordHintEdit.message: Leave empty to keep the saved password. It must be typed again if the server or the sign-in name changes.
passwordHintEdit.description: Hint under the password, existing mailbox.

nameHint.message: Shown in Thunderbird's account list. If left empty, the email address is used.

serverHint.message: For example mail.example.com, without /Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync. Always over HTTPS.

usernameHint.message: Fill in only if it differs from the email address, for example DOMAIN\name.

fieldPeriod.description: Label: how far back mail is synchronized.

periodHint.message: Applies to mail and calendar. Mail keeps at most 1 month unless you choose All: ActiveSync offers nothing in between. Future events are always synchronized.
periodHint.description: Hint under the period field of the mailbox form.

moreSettings.description: Title of the folded part of the mailbox form (account name, sign-in name, frequency).

fieldCaFingerprint.message: Fingerprint of a private certificate authority (optional)
fieldCaFingerprint.description: Label of the optional field, under More settings, for the SHA-256 fingerprint of a private certificate authority.

caFingerprintHint.message: Only if your server's certificate comes from an authority of your organization. Enter the SHA-256 fingerprint of that authority's certificate, or of the server's own, as your administrator gave it to you. Never copy it from a warning: on a network that intercepts connections, it would be the interceptor's. The authority must also be installed in Thunderbird or in the system.

caFingerprintInvalid.message: A SHA-256 fingerprint has 64 hexadecimal digits (colons and spaces are ignored).
caFingerprintInvalid.description: Error: the fingerprint typed is not 64 hexadecimal digits.

caFingerprintServerChanged.message: The server changed: a fingerprint holds for one server only. Enter it again for the new server, or leave this field empty.
caFingerprintServerChanged.description: Error: the server of the mailbox changed and the fingerprint was left as it was.

fieldKinds.description: Label of the group of check boxes.

permissionMissing.message: Without permission to access $SERVER$, the mailbox cannot be synchronized. Save again and accept Thunderbird's request.
permissionMissing.description: Error on the server field; $SERVER$: the server.

freqPush.description: Frequency choice: as soon as mail arrives (push).

freqEveryMinutes.description: Frequency choice; $COUNT$: a number of minutes (5 or more).

periodAll.description: Mail or calendar period choice: everything.

kindsNone.description: Summary of a mailbox that synchronizes nothing.

usernameTooLong.message: Sign-in name too long (256 characters at most).

usernameColon.message: The sign-in name must not contain a colon ( : ).

usernameBadChar.message: The sign-in name contains a character that is not allowed.

passwordRetype.message: The server or the sign-in name has changed: type the password again.

passwordBadChar.message: The password contains a character that is not allowed.

nameTooLong.message: Name too long (256 characters at most).

chooseCalendarPeriod.message: Choose the calendar period to synchronize.

chooseKind.message: Choose at least one item to synchronize.

serverEmpty.message: Enter the server, for example mail.example.com.

serverSpace.message: The server address must not contain spaces.

serverNotHttps.message: The server must be reachable over HTTPS.

serverCredentials.message: The server address must not contain a sign-in name or a password.

serverPortInvalid.description: Field error; $VALUE$: the port that was typed.

dateAtTime.description: A date and a time; $DAY$: the date (e.g. 12/11), $TIME$: the time (e.g. 14:05).

statusMassDelete.message: Synchronization paused: the server deleted $COUNT$ items at once (messages, events or tasks). These deletions will only be applied after your confirmation; you can also keep the local copies.
statusMassDelete.description: Status; $COUNT$: number of items (messages, events or tasks) the server deleted at once.

statusMassDeleteMany.message: Synchronization paused: the server deleted many items at once (messages, events or tasks). These deletions will only be applied after your confirmation; you can also keep the local copies.
statusMassDeleteMany.description: Status, when the number of deletions is not known.

statusBlocked.message: Stopped: $REASON$ Nothing will be attempted automatically: click “Synchronize” to resume.
statusBlocked.description: Status after a serious error; $REASON$: what happened, ending with a full stop. Quotes the syncButton button.

statusSeriousError.description: Reason of statusBlocked when none is known.

statusError.description: Status after an error; $REASON$: what happened, ending with a full stop.

statusErrorUnknown.description: Reason of statusError when none is known.

statusRetryAt.description: Follows statusError; $TIME$: when the next automatic attempt takes place.

statusSyncedOn.description: Status; $DATE$: an earlier day and its time (dateAtTime).

failedOne.message: 1 message could not be imported: it will be tried again automatically.
failedOne.description: Follows the status: a message (mail only; events and tasks have failedCalendarOne).

failedMany.message: $COUNT$ messages could not be imported: they will be tried again automatically.
failedMany.description: Follows the status; $COUNT$: number of messages (2 or more; mail only).

failedCalendarOne.message: 1 event or task could not be imported.
failedCalendarOne.description: Follows the status (and failedOne or failedMany, if any): an event or a task the calendar could not take.

failedCalendarMany.message: $COUNT$ events or tasks could not be imported.
failedCalendarMany.description: Follows the status; $COUNT$: number of events and tasks the calendar could not take (2 or more).

errorDetail.description: Tooltip of a status or an error: the engine's own reason, which is written in French.

diagnosticHint.message: The log contains no message content, subject or address. Debugging adds technical values (statuses, keys) to it and stops by itself after one hour. Log entries are written in French.

debugActiveUntil.description: Next to the check box; $TIME$: when debugging switches itself off.

levelError.description: Level of a log entry (8 characters at most).

levelWarn.description: Level of a log entry (8 characters at most).

levelInfo.description: Level of a log entry (8 characters at most).

levelDebug.description: Level of a log entry (8 characters at most).

emailFixed.message: The address of a mailbox cannot be changed: remove the mailbox and add a new one.

loginTaken.message: Another mailbox already uses this server with this sign-in name.

permissionRefused.message: Access to the server is not allowed: accept Thunderbird's request.

accountNotPrepared.message: The Thunderbird account could not be prepared ($CODE$).

passwordNotSaved.message: The password could not be saved (is the Primary Password locked?).
passwordNotSaved.description: Field error. “Primary Password” is Thunderbird's name for the password protecting saved passwords.

errorPasswordLocked.message: The password cannot be accessed at the moment.
errorPasswordLocked.description: Error: the password manager cannot be read for now (Primary Password not entered).

errorPasswordAbsent.message: No password saved: edit the mailbox to enter it.

errorAuth.message: The server refused the sign-in name or the password.
errorAuth.description: Engine error AUTH. $REASON$: the engine's own reason, written in French (the French catalogue shows it as it is; other languages may leave it out).

errorDenied.message: The server does not allow this account or this device to synchronize.
errorDenied.description: Engine error DENIED. $REASON$: the engine's own reason, written in French (the French catalogue shows it as it is; other languages may leave it out).

errorWipe.message: The server asked to wipe this device remotely. The request was refused: nothing was erased, and synchronization is stopped.
errorWipe.description: Engine error WIPE_REQUESTED. $REASON$: the engine's own reason, written in French (the French catalogue shows it as it is; other languages may leave it out).

errorConfig.message: The mailbox cannot be synchronized with its current settings: check them, then save the mailbox again.
errorConfig.description: Engine error CONFIG. $REASON$: the engine's own reason, written in French (the French catalogue shows it as it is; other languages may leave it out).

errorTls.message: Connection refused before the password was sent: the server's certificate was not accepted. The network may be intercepting HTTPS connections. If your server uses a certificate authority of your organization, enter its fingerprint under “More settings”.
errorTls.description: Engine error TLS. $REASON$: the engine's own reason, written in French (the French catalogue shows it as it is; other languages may leave it out).

errorProxyAuth.message: This network's proxy requires its own authentication, which is not supported yet.
errorProxyAuth.description: Engine error PROXY_AUTH. $REASON$: the engine's own reason, written in French (the French catalogue shows it as it is; other languages may leave it out).

errorProvision.message: The exchange of security policies with the server failed.
errorProvision.description: Engine error PROVISION. $REASON$: the engine's own reason, written in French (the French catalogue shows it as it is; other languages may leave it out).

errorHttp.message: The server responded with an HTTP error.
errorHttp.description: Engine error HTTP. $REASON$: the engine's own reason, written in French (the French catalogue shows it as it is; other languages may leave it out).

errorBusy.message: The server is busy, or too many connections are open.
errorBusy.description: Engine error BUSY. $REASON$: the engine's own reason, written in French (the French catalogue shows it as it is; other languages may leave it out).

errorNetwork.description: Engine error NETWORK. $REASON$: the engine's own reason, written in French (the French catalogue shows it as it is; other languages may leave it out).

errorTimeout.message: The server did not respond in time.
errorTimeout.description: Engine error TIMEOUT. $REASON$: the engine's own reason, written in French (the French catalogue shows it as it is; other languages may leave it out).

errorTooLarge.message: The server's response is too large.
errorTooLarge.description: Engine error TOO_LARGE. $REASON$: the engine's own reason, written in French (the French catalogue shows it as it is; other languages may leave it out).

errorBadResponse.message: The server sent an unexpected or invalid response.
errorBadResponse.description: Engine error BAD_RESPONSE. $REASON$: the engine's own reason, written in French (the French catalogue shows it as it is; other languages may leave it out).

errorCancelled.description: Engine error CANCELLED. $REASON$: the engine's own reason, written in French (the French catalogue shows it as it is; other languages may leave it out).

errorServer.description: Engine error SERVER. $REASON$: the engine's own reason, written in French (the French catalogue shows it as it is; other languages may leave it out).

errorLocal.message: The changes could not be written into Thunderbird.
errorLocal.description: Engine error LOCAL. $REASON$: the engine's own reason, written in French (the French catalogue shows it as it is; other languages may leave it out).

errorClosed.message: The synchronization of this mailbox has stopped.
errorClosed.description: Engine error CLOSED. $REASON$: the engine's own reason, written in French (the French catalogue shows it as it is; other languages may leave it out).

errorOther.description: Engine error of another kind. $REASON$: the engine's own reason, written in French (the French catalogue shows it as it is; other languages may leave it out).

sendBusy.message: This message is already being sent.

sendProtected.message: Message not sent: signing and encryption (OpenPGP, S/MIME) are not supported by Sync443 yet, or their state could not be checked. Turn them off for this message. It remains in the compose window.

sendAccountUnchecked.message: Message not sent: Sync443 could not check the sending account, so nothing was sent. The message remains in the compose window.

sendRouteUnchecked.message: Message not sent: Sync443 could not check this account's outgoing server, so nothing was sent. The message remains in the compose window.

sendUnexpected.message: Message not sent: unexpected error. It remains in the compose window.

sendFailed.message: Message not sent: $REASON$ It remains in the compose window.
sendFailed.description: Notification; $REASON$: why (one of the sendReason… messages, or an error), ending with a full stop.

sendFailedDraft.message: Message not sent: $REASON$ It remains in the compose window and in the drafts.
sendFailedDraft.description: Notification, the message also saved as a draft; $REASON$: as in sendFailed.

sendUncertain.message: Sending uncertain: $REASON$ Check the Sent folder before sending the message again; it remains in the compose window.

sendReasonDraft.message: the draft could not be saved.

sendReasonDetails.message: the compose window could not be read again.

sendReasonIdentity.message: the sender changed while the message was being sent. Click Send again.

sendReasonProtection.message: signing or encryption (OpenPGP, S/MIME) was asked for, which Sync443 does not support yet.

sendReasonFolder.message: the draft was not saved in this sender's Sync443 account. Check the identity's drafts folder.

sendReasonEncrypted.message: encrypted messages (OpenPGP, S/MIME) cannot be sent by Sync443.

sendReasonMime.message: the message could not be prepared.

sendReasonTooLarge.description: Reason (in sendFailed); $SIZE$: a size in megabytes.

sendReasonRead.message: the draft could not be read.

sendReasonStatus.message: unexpected response from the server; the message may already have left.

sendReasonInterrupted.message: the connection was interrupted after the request was sent; the message may already have left.

sendReasonLowercase.description: A setting, not a text: “yes” if a reason that follows “Message not sent:” (one of the engine's errors) starts with a lower-case letter in this language, “no” otherwise (German, where nouns keep their capital; languages without letter case). Only “yes” or “no”.

sendReasonRefused.description: Reason (in sendFailed); $REASON$: one of the sendStatus… messages; $STATUS$: the server's status code.

sendStatus107.message: the server refuses the format of the message

sendStatus111.message: temporary server error, try again later

sendStatus113.message: the mailbox is full on the server

sendStatus114.message: the mailbox is temporarily unavailable on the server

sendStatus115.message: the server's sending quota is exceeded

sendStatus116.message: a recipient was not recognized by the server

sendStatus118.message: the server indicates that this message has already been sent

sendStatus120.message: the server could not deliver the message

sendStatus122.message: attachment too large for the server

sentLeftoverDraft.message: Message sent, but its draft could not be deleted: do not send it again.

sentLeftoverWindow.message: Message sent, but the compose window could not be closed: do not send it again.

sentLeftoverBoth.message: Message sent, but its draft could not be deleted and the compose window could not be closed: do not send it again.

confirmTitle.description: Title of the window that asks before a meeting message (invitation, update, cancellation) is sent.

confirmAskInvite.message: Send the invitation to this meeting?
confirmAskInvite.description: Question of the confirmation window: the user created a meeting, its invitation is ready to be sent.

confirmAskUpdate.message: Send the updated invitation to this meeting?
confirmAskUpdate.description: Question of the confirmation window: the user changed a meeting, its updated invitation is ready to be sent.

confirmAskCancel.message: Send the cancellation of this meeting?
confirmAskCancel.description: Question of the confirmation window: the user cancelled a meeting, its cancellation is ready to be sent.

confirmHint.message: Your change is already saved. Without this message, the recipients will not be informed of it.
confirmHint.description: Under the question of the confirmation window: what happens if the message is not sent.

confirmLabelEvent.description: Label before the title of the event, in the confirmation window.

confirmLabelWhen.description: Label before the date and time at which the event starts, in the confirmation window. No colon.

confirmLabelFrom.description: Label before the address of the mailbox that sends the message, in the confirmation window. No colon.

confirmAllDay.description: Date of an all-day event, shown without a time; $DATE$: the date, written out in full.

confirmRecipientsOne.description: Heading of the list of recipients, when there is one.

confirmRecipientsMany.description: Heading of the list of recipients; $COUNT$: their number (2 to 100). In languages whose plural depends on the number, put the number after a colon.

confirmSend.description: Button of the confirmation window: send the meeting message.

confirmDontSend.description: Button of the confirmation window: send nothing (the event stays as saved). The safe choice, focused by default.

confirmSending.description: Shown in the confirmation window after “Send”, until Sync443 has taken the message.

confirmClose.description: Button: close the confirmation window, when there is nothing to confirm any more.

confirmExpired.message: This request is no longer valid: it has already been answered, or it has expired.
confirmExpired.description: Shown instead of the question when the confirmation can no longer be given (unknown, already used, or older than 10 minutes). Followed by confirmNothingSent.

confirmNothingSent.message: Nothing will be sent from this window.
confirmNothingSent.description: Follows confirmExpired, or an unexpected answer of the extension, in the confirmation window.

confirmUncertain.message: Sync443 did not answer: the message may not have been sent. Check the Sent folder before sending it again.
confirmUncertain.description: Shown in the confirmation window when the user clicked “Send” and Sync443 gave no answer.

meetingSubjectInvite.description: Subject of an invitation sent to the attendees of a meeting; $SUMMARY$: the title of the event. Read by other people, in their mail.

meetingSubjectUpdate.description: Subject of an updated invitation sent to the attendees of a meeting; $SUMMARY$: the title of the event.

meetingSubjectCancel.description: Subject of the message telling the attendees that a meeting is cancelled; $SUMMARY$: the title of the event.

meetingSubjectAccepted.description: Subject of the reply telling the organizer that the user accepted an invitation; $SUMMARY$: the title of the event.

meetingSubjectTentative.description: Subject of the reply telling the organizer that the user accepted an invitation tentatively; $SUMMARY$: the title of the event.

meetingSubjectDeclined.description: Subject of the reply telling the organizer that the user declined an invitation; $SUMMARY$: the title of the event.

meetingTextWhen.description: Line of the plain-text part of a meeting message; $WHEN$: the date and time of the event.

meetingTextWhere.description: Line of the plain-text part of a meeting message; $LOCATION$: the location of the event.

meetingNoTitle.description: Stands for the title of an event or a task that has none (subjects, notifications, the confirmation window).

calendarSendFailed.message: The meeting message for “$SUMMARY$” was not sent: $REASON$ The event is saved, but the attendees were not informed.
calendarSendFailed.description: Notification: an invitation, update or cancellation was refused. $SUMMARY$: the title of the event; $REASON$: why (an error message), ending with a full stop.

calendarSendUncertain.message: The meeting message for “$SUMMARY$” may not have been sent: the connection was lost. Check the Sent folder before sending it again.
calendarSendUncertain.description: Notification: the connection was lost while an invitation, update or cancellation was being sent; it is never sent again automatically. $SUMMARY$: the title of the event.

calendarTooManyAttendees.message: “$SUMMARY$” has more than $MAX$ attendees: Sync443 cannot send its invitations. The change was undone.
calendarTooManyAttendees.description: Notification: a meeting has too many attendees for its invitations to be sent. $SUMMARY$: the title of the event; $MAX$: the largest number of attendees allowed (100). In languages whose plural depends on the number, put the number after a colon.

calendarAnswerFailed.message: Your answer to “$SUMMARY$” could not be sent: $REASON$ The event is back as it was.
calendarAnswerFailed.description: Notification: the user's answer to an invitation (accept, tentative, decline) was refused. $SUMMARY$: the title of the event; $REASON$: why (an error message), ending with a full stop.

calendarAnswerNoInvitation.message: Your answer to “$SUMMARY$” could not be sent: its invitation was not found on the server. The event is back as it was.
calendarAnswerNoInvitation.description: Notification: the user's answer to an invitation could not be sent, because the invitation mail is no longer on the server. $SUMMARY$: the title of the event.

calendarAnswerNeedsMail.message: Your answer to “$SUMMARY$” could not be sent: answering invitations on this server requires mail to be synchronized for this mailbox.
calendarAnswerNeedsMail.description: Notification: the user's answer to an invitation could not be sent, because this server needs the invitation mail and mail is not synchronized for the mailbox. $SUMMARY$: the title of the event.

calendarChangeRefused.message: The server refused a change to “$SUMMARY$”. The server's version is restored.
calendarChangeRefused.description: Notification: the server refused a change the user made to an event or a task. $SUMMARY$: its title.

calendarRecurrenceUnsupported.message: The repetition of “$SUMMARY$” cannot be saved on an ActiveSync server. The change was undone.
calendarRecurrenceUnsupported.description: Notification: the user gave an event or a task a repetition rule that ActiveSync cannot express. $SUMMARY$: its title.

calendarReadOnly.message: “$SUMMARY$” cannot be changed from Thunderbird. The change was undone.
calendarReadOnly.description: Notification: the user changed an event or a task that Sync443 only shows (read-only). $SUMMARY$: its title.

calendarTooLarge.message: “$SUMMARY$” is too large to be saved on the server. The change was undone.
calendarTooLarge.description: Notification: an event or a task is too large for the server after the user's change. $SUMMARY$: its title.

calendarKeptLocal.message: “$SUMMARY$” could not be saved on the server. It stays in Thunderbird as a local copy that is no longer synchronized.
calendarKeptLocal.description: Notification: an event or a task could not be saved on the server; it stays in Thunderbird, detached from the server. $SUMMARY$: its title.

calendarServerChanged.message: “$SUMMARY$” was changed on the server before your change was sent. The server's version is shown; your change was not sent.
calendarServerChanged.description: Notification: the server changed an event or a task while a change of the user's was waiting to be sent; the server's version wins. $SUMMARY$: its title.

calendarDetached.message: “$SUMMARY$” is no longer the same item on the server. Your version stays in Thunderbird as a local copy that is no longer synchronized.
calendarDetached.description: Notification: after the server rebuilt its list, the item the user changed is no longer the same item there; the user's version stays as a local copy. $SUMMARY$: its title.

calendarRestoreUnsupported.message: An occurrence of “$SUMMARY$” that was changed or deleted cannot be put back into its series on an ActiveSync server. The change was undone.
calendarRestoreUnsupported.description: Notification: the user put an occurrence that was changed or deleted back into its repeating event, which ActiveSync cannot express. $SUMMARY$: the title of the event.

calendarOrganizerChanged.message: The organizer of “$SUMMARY$” was changed in Thunderbird: no message was sent to the attendees.
calendarOrganizerChanged.description: Notification: a change made in Thunderbird replaced the organizer of a meeting, so no invitation, update, cancellation or reply was sent. $SUMMARY$: the title of the event.

calendarNotSentExpired.message: The meeting message for “$SUMMARY$” was not sent: the confirmation was not answered in time. The event is saved, but the attendees were not informed.
calendarNotSentExpired.description: Notification: the confirmation window of a meeting message stayed unanswered for 10 minutes; the message was not sent. $SUMMARY$: the title of the event.

calendarNotSentFull.message: The meeting message for “$SUMMARY$” was not sent: too many messages are waiting. The event is saved, but the attendees were not informed.
calendarNotSentFull.description: Notification: a meeting message could not be queued because too many are waiting already; it was not sent. $SUMMARY$: the title of the event.

calendarNotSentOld.message: The meeting message for “$SUMMARY$” was not sent: it had been waiting for more than a day. The event is saved, but the attendees were not informed.
calendarNotSentOld.description: Notification: a meeting message waited more than 24 hours for its confirmation; it was dropped without being sent. $SUMMARY$: the title of the event.

calendarChangesDroppedOne.message: One change made in Thunderbird was not sent: its calendar is no longer synchronized with the server. A new item stays in Thunderbird as a local copy.
calendarChangesDroppedOne.description: Notification: one change the user made could not be sent because its calendar or task list is no longer synchronized (gone from the server, or unknown). See calendarChangesDroppedMany for several.

calendarChangesDroppedMany.message: $COUNT$ changes made in Thunderbird were not sent: their calendar is no longer synchronized with the server. New items stay in Thunderbird as local copies.
calendarChangesDroppedMany.description: Notification: several changes the user made could not be sent because their calendar or task list is no longer synchronized (gone from the server, or unknown); $COUNT$: their number (2 or more). In languages whose plural depends on the number, put the number after a colon.

contactsChangesDroppedOne.message: One change made to a contact in Thunderbird was not sent: its address book is no longer synchronized with the server. A new contact stays in Thunderbird as a local copy.
contactsChangesDroppedOne.description: Notification: one local change to a contact was dropped because its address book is no longer synchronized.

contactsChangesDroppedMany.message: $COUNT$ changes made to contacts in Thunderbird were not sent: their address book is no longer synchronized with the server. New contacts stay in Thunderbird as local copies.
contactsChangesDroppedMany.description: Notification: several local changes to contacts were dropped. $COUNT$ is their number (2 or more).

calendarReplyNotSent.message: Your answer to “$SUMMARY$” is saved in your calendar, but no reply was sent to the organizer: the invitation was not found in this mailbox.
calendarReplyNotSent.description: Notification: the user answered an invitation and asked for a reply, but no invitation mail could be named in the mailbox, so the answer was only saved; no reply went to the organizer. $SUMMARY$: the title of the event.

calendarKeptLocalTooManyAttendees.message: “$SUMMARY$” has more than $MAX$ attendees: Sync443 cannot send its invitations. It stays in Thunderbird as a local copy that is no longer synchronized.
calendarKeptLocalTooManyAttendees.description: Notification: a new meeting has too many attendees for its invitations to be sent; it stays in Thunderbird, detached from the server. $SUMMARY$: its title; $MAX$: the largest number of attendees allowed (100). In languages whose plural depends on the number, put the number after a colon.

calendarKeptLocalRecurrence.message: The repetition of “$SUMMARY$” cannot be saved on an ActiveSync server. It stays in Thunderbird as a local copy that is no longer synchronized.
calendarKeptLocalRecurrence.description: Notification: a new event or task has a repetition rule ActiveSync cannot express; it stays in Thunderbird, detached from the server. $SUMMARY$: its title.

calendarKeptLocalTooLarge.message: “$SUMMARY$” is too large to be saved on the server. It stays in Thunderbird as a local copy that is no longer synchronized.
calendarKeptLocalTooLarge.description: Notification: a new event or task is too large for the server; it stays in Thunderbird, detached from the server. $SUMMARY$: its title.
